emailDrafts.subject: Checking in with warmth — Arjun’s enrollment folder
emailDrafts.body:
Dear Maya and Dev,

It was such a joy watching Arjun examine our classroom ferns on Thursday! Whenever you have a quiet moment this week, feel free to drop his immunization card into your shared Love School Drive folder—no rush at all, and please reply if I can help with anything.

Warmly,
Clara Vance
Director, Love School

emailDrafts.subject: A quick note on Zion’s November tuition & studio welcome

Hi Nadia,

With gratitude,
Clara Vance
Love School

notionUnits.title: Autumn Botany & Watercolor Field Journals
notionUnits.themeSummary: Children collect fallen maple, oak, and birch leaves, observe venation under brass loupes, and paint slow observational studies.
notionUnits.familyPrompt: On a walk this weekend, ask your child to pick one fallen leaf and notice three tiny details you might otherwise walk past.
notionUnits.teacherPrep: Fresh cold-press watercolor blocks, brass magnifying glasses, linen table cloths.

notionUnits.title: Woodland Folktales & Cozy Reading Circle
notionUnits.themeSummary: Oral storytelling with felt woodland figures, rhyming rhythm games, and unhurried picture book exploration by the sunlit window.
notionUnits.familyPrompt: Share a story from your own childhood before bedtime this week—children love hearing your voice without a book in hand.
notionUnits.teacherPrep: Display "The Wild Garden" and "Luna & The Owl" in the low birch reading nook.

notionUnits.title: Tension, Span & Community Bridges
notionUnits.themeSummary: Hands-on engineering studio investigating truss geometry, weight distribution, and how bridges connect neighborhoods.
notionUnits.familyPrompt: Notice a local pedestrian bridge or archway together and sketch its shapes.
notionUnits.teacherPrep: Corrugated kraft board, jute twine, brass weights for load testing.

socialPosts.title: Slow Mornings at the Botany Table
socialPosts.caption: Before rushing into answers, we give children time to look closely. This week in Lower Elementary Explorers, fallen oak and maple leaves became our quiet teachers—paired with watercolor sketchbooks and brass magnifying glasses. #LoveSchool #RelationshipCenteredLearning

socialPosts.title: By the Sunlit Reading Window
socialPosts.caption: A corner built for wonder, wool rugs, and unhurried stories. Spring & Fall family tours are open at loveschoolu.com—come sit in the morning light with us.

socialPosts.title: Open Studio Morning — Meet Our Guides
socialPosts.caption: Looking for a school where your child is truly known? Book a 45-minute Campus Visit through loveschoolu.com and share a cup of tea in our studio.
